title: Am I Not Good Enough to Be Your Sex Partner?
overview: It wasn't easy for Shirasaki to get his new leading role, and his doubt and lack of self-confidence are interfering with his performance.

title: The Kiss Continues at Home... A Secret Just Between Us
overview: Hayama encourages Shirasaki to be more confident in his work through their secret arrangement and by going on a date together.

title: A Secret Date at Home!? The Two of Us in a Double Bed...
overview: Hayama goes over to Shirasaki's house after work and soothes his worries with curry and his company.

title: Are These Special Feelings Just for the Drama... or Something More!?
overview: Shirasaki's hard work starts paying off and he starts getting a taste of fame, but he has less chances to spend time with the busy Hayama.

title: Overnight Filming at a Hot Spring Resort… A Forbidden Love Triangle Begins!?
overview: Yamase's sudden appearance starts to negatively affect Hayama, and the interactions between Yamase and Shirasaki give Hayama cause for concern.

title: The Someone I Can Never Forget
overview: Shirasaki inadvertently hears Hayama say something that leaves him deeply dejected during a meal.

title: The Most Beautiful Memory
overview: Hayama first noticed Shirasaki at a club when he was in college and never thought he would meet him again after so many years.

title: Our Starting Point
overview: Before the wrapping of the show, Hayama returns to his alma mater to reflect on the past.

title: I Want You to Sleep with Me
overview: Shirasaki and Hayama have finally finished filming; does this mean that their relationship is coming to an end?

title: Goodbye, Asami-san
overview: Shirasaki and Hayama are finally able to enjoy being intimate together, but Shirasaki seems to have some misgivings about their relationship.

title: Where Our Bond Leads Us
overview: Yuki and Hayama’s blissful new romance is shaken when an unexpected incident tests their trust.

title: Let’s Break Up
overview: Caught by their manager, Yuki and Hayama are told to end things just as their drama mirrors real life.

title: My Lover Is My Rival
overview: Yuki and Hayama move in together, but a new audition brings Yuki face to face with his idol director.

title: I Don’t Want to Lose
overview: Rivals on stage, Yuki and Hayama must compete for the same role while their love hangs in the balance.

title: To Choose and Be Chosen
overview: Hayama faces a painful choice between his dream role on stage and a career-defining film offer.

title: Experience, Memory, and Emotion
overview: As Yuki struggles under a harsh director, Hayama’s film role pushes him to face his deepest emotions.

title: What Do You Know About Me?!
overview: As Shirasaki’s slump deepens, he makes a desperate request of Hayama—just as Hayama’s past resurfaces.

title: An Emotion I Never Knew
overview: Hayama is proud of Shirasaki’s growing success, yet jealousy toward Kuroki quietly creeps in. At the same time, a sudden film offer from his father forces him into a difficult decision.

title: What Truly Matters
overview: Haunted by memories of his mother, Hayama falters on set and clashes with Shirasaki—until Haruka suddenly appears before him.

title: The Curtain Rises
overview: After the play’s triumphant debut, Hayama and Shirasaki confront their true feelings—both as actors and as something more.
